title: X Premium Retention Offer 1 Year $72 (Usually $120) @ X
body:
Deal: X Premium Retention Offer 1 Year $72 (Usually $120) @ X

[GregRust] I don’t use it for free, let alone paying for it.
[bargain-dev] I'm not a fan of paying for social media either, but if you're going to get the use out of Grok I think it's fairly worth it - and the new Grok 4.6 is supposed to be relatively good.
[Mr BoMBAStiG] I was constantly switching to Grok Build when I hit Claude Pro limits. Ended up just cancelling Claude and going in on Supergrok+ and I never hit limits and now playing with Grok Bot.
Fable def better but bang for buck, Grok wins.
[bargain-dev] Yeah, I'm not really getting the negs here.
[odysseus] @bargain-dev: Grok was so bad/useless i.e. gave false information and argued about it that I blocked it. It wasted more time than it was worth.
[Xheis] @bargain-dev: Grok famously has been shit for data security. E.g.
"Grok Build Uploaded Entire Git Repositories to xAI Storage, Not Just Files It Read"
https://thehackernews.com/2026/07/grok-build-uploads-entire-…
If it's worth paying for, it's worth paying for something via Open router to avoid the Grok infra.
[FrugalSquid] why did you comment if it doesnt affect you then?
[Lizard Spock] That reminds me, my Club X membership is due soon.
[SBOB] Remember the use of negative vote guidelines to save me the hassle of reporting any non-compliance.
Good point, though I thought X users where outspoken advocates of free speech, not being censored in their opinions, and that compliance was just for sheeple?
[Ezekiel2320] Elon "Free Speech Absolutist Except When It's About Tracking My Plane" Musk.
It would be like paying to watch Sky news 🤣
[Onemoredeal] When you know your post is average so include a neg reporting warning
[probablynotlauren] Yeah what the heck is that threat lol. Lame.
[Elephant] It was a crap deal originally to pay for social media (especially since this one's gone to the dogs). And having Grok attached isn't a bonus. You dont want to be associated with, or funnel money to child exploitation.
Negging because I'm letting others know "about issues with the deal, merchant or product."
Lame post along with it. Report me bro
[odysseus] "premium website"? lol
It'd need way fewer outages, useful functionality being removed, selective speech being promoted, and recurring promotion of bots/misidentification of genuine content just to achieve standard/reasonable. It's nowhere near "premium". And certainly nowhere justified payment to get a mislabeled "verified" account.
[bargainatoraah] Since Elon is literally hitler it’s a no from me
[M00Cow] Elon is literally hitler
Got that fact from Grok?
[ratmanuwu] What day/night will be the wildest party on your island?
[visitorsonlyparking] I use X but paying for the subscription is a joke
[noisymime] If someone forced me to either pay for this or throw the $72 in a fire, those notes are going to be melting in no time.
[GregRust] Genuinely would rather set fire to $72 than give it to Elon Musk.
[fantombloo] Would rather set fire to Elon Musk than $72.
[SpiffyTheDog] Careful, this guy doesn't want to have to be the vote police while he shills for a trillionaire's nazi site 🤣
[mmrazz] Surely them paying me $120 is better than them paying me $72?
Ohh.. wait.. you mean I need to pay that much to use it? bawhahwahw. Yeah, right.
[TheDukeOfNukem] Me: The (profanity) is X Premium?
3 seconds pass
Oh, it's Twitter Premium.
3 more seconds pass
The (profanity) is Twitter Premium?
[BuyoTheCat] Exercising elon’s right for double standards to his product on a site that exercise democracy to the point of anarchy
[Churna] Been using Grok for some time and now use grok Bot. Both pretty good.
Also, people downvoting because it’s X, is there any better social media for when something is happening around the world to get instant news? Other then wait a few hours to get the info elsewhere
